PM Modi to launch projects worth over Rs 13,000 crore in Chennai

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Chennai on Sunday to launch projects valued at over Rs 13,000 crore. Security measures, including at Chennai Airport and travel routes, have been fortified in anticipation of his visit.
